oracle.instrumentation_policy: No instrumentation: the fixture drives the public RuleStoreVarnode/RuleLoadVarnode::applyOp and Funcdata::spacebase entry points of the locked oracle; observations read only public state (Varnode space/offset/size, isStackStore, PcodeOp opcode/inputs).

analysis_options.entry: Direct ActionConstantPtr::apply calls over hand-built Funcdata IR (one COPY(Const,addr) + INT_EQUAL web per case), on a BfdArchitecture whose global scope carries a char[6] container symbol at 0x4e000; inferPtrSpaces read directly from the Architecture after full spec init
analysis_options.container_symbol: global scope char[6] 'ptemp_sim' at ram:0x4e000 (Scope::addSymbol database.cc:1530) + miss address 0x4f001
analysis_options.normalization: Stable case names only. Unique-space offsets and raw space-id constant values are not observed on either side (allocation-only temporaries / process-local space-id encodings). No flags, input order, opcode, output size, type metatype, or charPrint-pointee state is normalized.

ARCH-0001.detail: Rugra's enum-space Architecture stands in for Ghidra's AddrSpace* registry: getSpaceBySpacebase/getContain are keyed by the AddressSpace enum + flattened stack_* config rather than per-space record stores. This fixture proves the observable spacebase-resolution behavior (9/9 records byte-identical) but not full AddrSpace object identity.

CALLSPECS-0001.detail: RuleLoadVarnode::applyOp spacebase-placeholder tail (ruleaction.cc:4294-4303, resolveSpacebaseRelative via FuncCallSpecs) is not modeled in Rugra; the fixture's LOAD case has no spacebase-placeholder output so the tail is unreached on both sides.

SCOPELOCAL-0001.detail: RuleStoreVarnode::applyOp isStoreUnmapped/markNotMapped tail (ruleaction.cc:4337-4339) needs ScopeLocal::markNotMapped, not modeled in Rugra; the fixture's STORE is not store-unmapped so the tail is unreached on both sides.

overall_status: MATCH: inferPtrSpaces registry (register-space filter) + 3 ActionConstantPtr cases (sz8 container hit converts to PTRSUB charPrint-pointer, sz4 flag-web constant stays bare at the same address, sz8 no-container miss) are byte-identical under the locked oracle; ARCH-0001 enum-space stand-in remains a known MISMATCH at the full-state level and CALLSPECS-0001/SCOPELOCAL-0001 tails remain UNTESTED
